mobdefense.help.dispenser_mount.use.1: Fire: accessory action 1 – a button or
mobdefense.help.dispenser_mount.use.2: switch on the radio, keyboard Numpad 9.
mobdefense.help.dispenser_mount.use.4: Right-click ends the flight, as with every drone.
mobdefense.help.spear_mount.use.2: Hits by itself from 4.6 m/s along the nose.
mobdefense.help.rocket_booster.use.3: reload it in the service menu after landing.
mobdefense.guide.scene.dispenser.title: Mob Defense: Dispenser
mobdefense.guide.scene.dispenser.descrip: Load the dispenser mount and fire with accessory action 1
mobdefense.guide.scene.dispenser.step.lo: Four slots for arrows, potions, wind charges, TNT and more. Load them in the service menu: sneak and right-click the landed drone.
mobdefense.guide.scene.dispenser.callout: Four slots, fires straight ahead – aim with the whole drone
Sneak + right-click the landed drone: service menu
mobdefense.guide.scene.dispenser.step.fi: Accessory action 1 fires: best on a button of your radio, Numpad 9 on the keyboard. Held, it keeps firing. Right-click ends the flight.
mobdefense.guide.scene.dispenser.hint.ex: Right-click ends the flight – it does not fire
mobdefense.guide.scene.dispenser.step.sl: Accessory action 2 picks the next filled slot. The OSD shows slot, ammo and count, e.g. DSP 2 ARW 12.
mobdefense.guide.scene.dispenser.callout: OSD: DSP 2 ARW 12 – slot, ammo, count; * while cooling down
TNT is allowed by default, fluid buckets are locked – world rules change that
mobdefense.guide.scene.spear.title: Mob Defense: Spear
mobdefense.guide.scene.spear.description: Mount a spear under the drone and hit mobs in passing
The spear mount takes exactly one spear, tip forward, from wood to netherite. Tridents, swords and sticks do not fit.
mobdefense.guide.scene.spear.callout.onl: Only spears – load it in the service menu
No button needed: the spear hits by itself. The dispenser fires on accessory action 1; right-click ends the flight.
mobdefense.guide.scene.spear.callout.spe: From 4.6 m/s along the nose: full vanilla spear damage, at most 15
mobdefense.guide.scene.spear.callout.dur: Each hit costs durability – the OSD shows SPR and the rest in percent
mobdefense.guide.scene.booster.title: Mob Defense: Rocket booster
mobdefense.guide.scene.booster.descripti: One firework rocket for a boost like with elytra
mobdefense.guide.scene.booster.step.load: The booster sits on top and holds exactly one firework rocket. Reload it in the service menu after landing.
mobdefense.guide.scene.booster.callout.o: Exactly one rocket – reload after landing
mobdefense.guide.scene.booster.step.igni: Accessory action 3 ignites: 2 g along the nose. Accessory action 1 fires the dispenser; right-click ends the flight.
mobdefense.guide.scene.booster.callout.s: Rockets with stars explode at the end – that hurts the drone too

advancements.mobdefense.root.description: Get an accessory from Mob Defense
advancements.mobdefense.air_support.desc: Hit another player with a healing potion from a drone's dispenser
advancements.mobdefense.lance_flight.des: Defeat a mob with the spear mount
advancements.mobdefense.recoil.title: Recoil
advancements.mobdefense.recoil.descripti: Fire a wind charge from the dispenser
